free_tier.stated: 9.3 GB maximum per file, no per-dataset or per-collection quota configured. Dutch national repository (KNAW/NWO); deposit is free for researchers at Dutch institutions and for EASY-migrated data.

egress.terms: Free, unmetered; Dataverse-native presigned S3 redirect for public files. No egress pricing.

record.tooling: Full Dataverse REST API (probe: GET https://ssh.datastations.nl/api/info/version -> 200; DataverseNL -> '6.10.1 DANS-DataStation-PATCH-9'), SWORD v2, OAI-PMH.
record.chaining: 9.3 GB/file x unlimited files per dataset x unlimited datasets. No enforced collection quota on either :root or the SSH station: GET /api/dataverses/root/storage/quota?showInherited=true -> 'No quota defined'. 2,200 files = 20 TB.
record.limits_note: 9.3 GB per file; UI upload must finish within 1.5 h; 2,000 files max inside a zip; 1,000 files per UI batch; 100-minute session timeout. Access is gated on affiliation in practice (DANS is for Dutch-institution research).
record.reliability_note: Tightly coupled to Dutch institutional eligibility, so account supply is the limit rather than bytes; otherwise a mature Dataverse instance with no storage cliff.

evidence.proved: 'Yes, a file can be 9,3 GB max. But you can upload as many files as you want to a dataset.'
(28/03/2024) — 9.3 GB/file, 2000 files per zip, 1.5 h UI timeout
